extracted.name: Oat Bran Bread
extracted.description: This oat bran bread is a light, high-volume bread. The dough is made in a bread machine, left to rise in a greased loaf pan, and baked in the oven.
ingredient_lines: 1.25 cups warm water (110 degrees F/45 degrees C)
instruction_lines: Place warm water, margarine, honey, bread flour, oat bran, salt, and yeast into a bread machine in the order listed, or follow the order recommended by your manufacturer if different.
After dough has risen once, remove it from the machine. Knead dough a few times, then shape into a loaf. Place into a greased 9x5-inch loaf pan and let rise until doubled in size, about 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven until done, 35 to 40 minutes, or until done.
